name: github

actions_cache_usage.comment: One current repository cache-usage observation. Organization listing and repository lookup share repository identity. Counters refresh about every five minutes and may differ from a separately enumerated live cache inventory. Route actions_cache_usage__organizations, selected by organization: Organization usage listing, with each returned repository hydrated to its canonical ID. Repositories absent from this API listing are not synthesized. Route actions_cache_usage__repositories, selected by owner, repository, organization, repositories: All visible rows in the selected repository or repository cohort, preserving all Link pages.

tags.github.retrieval_routes: [{"name": "actions_cache_usage__organizations", "population": "Organization usage listing, with each returned repository hydrated to its canonical ID. Repositories absent from this API listing are not synthesized.", "selection": ["organization"]}, {"name": "actions_cache_usage__repositories", "population": "All visible rows in the selected repository or repository cohort, preserving all Link pages.", "selection": ["owner", "repository", "organization", "repositories"]}]

actions_caches.comment: Current Actions cache inventory, distinct from artifacts. Cache keys and versions are attributes rather than identities; missing cache IDs fail explicit qualification. Cache inventories can change during pagination and do not represent historic storage usage. Route actions_caches__repositories, selected by owner, repository, organization, repositories: All visible rows in the selected repository or repository cohort, preserving all Link pages.

tags.github.retrieval_routes: [{"name": "actions_caches__repositories", "population": "All visible rows in the selected repository or repository cohort, preserving all Link pages.", "selection": ["owner", "repository", "organization", "repositories"]}]

actions_concurrency_groups.comment: Current repository concurrency-group observations identified by repository and group name. Typed group_members describe repository-wide leases or the explicitly selected queue prefix. Group URLs are evidence, not followed directly. last_acquired_at is supplied only by list discovery and remains NULL on direct lookup. Inactive groups are absent from repository inventory and return 404 by name; configured run/group memberships use their own association grain. Route actions_concurrency_groups__ahead_of_runs, selected by ahead_of_run_id: Current repository-wide queue, or an explicitly requested prefix through the selected run/job. Missing or inactive groups fail with the API status. Route actions_concurrency_groups__ahead_of_jobs, selected by ahead_of_job_id: Current repository-wide queue, or an explicitly requested prefix through the selected run/job. Missing or inactive groups fail with the API status. Route actions_concurrency_groups__lookup, selected by concurrency_group: Current repository-wide queue, or an explicitly requested prefix through the selected run/job. Missing or inactive groups fail with the API status. git_tree_entry_count.comment: Returned tree/path entries in the selected direct or recursive population; includes directories and submodules.

gitignore_template_count.comment: Canonical catalog records selected by listing or exact key; list entries are hydrated to the same complete detail shape.

idle_agent_task_count.comment: Tasks whose current API state is idle.

ignored_repository_subscription_count.comment: Selected repository subscription observations explicitly marked ignored.

in_progress_agent_task_count.comment: Tasks whose current API state is in_progress.

issue_active_days.comment: Distinct UTC creation dates represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across repositories and other overlapping groups; inactive dates contribute zero.

issue_applied_suggestion_count.comment: Suggestions whose current lifecycle state is applied.

issue_assignable_count.comment: Observed capability responses with HTTP 204; other statuses are not counted as confirmed assignability.

issue_assignment_capability_count.comment: Explicit capability observations for one login in repository or issue context, including 404 responses.

issue_assignment_count.comment: Current issue-or-PR/user assignment pairs, not unique assignees across issues.

issue_comment_active_days.comment: Distinct UTC creation dates represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across repositories and other overlapping groups; inactive dates contribute zero.

issue_comment_count.comment: Canonical issue and PR conversation comment identities in the selected repository, thread, exact or authored population; not review submissions or distinct issues. Only the authored route proves selected-user authorship.

issue_comment_repository_count.comment: Distinct known repository identities represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across dates/categories; unknown repository context is excluded.

issue_count.comment: Canonical visible Issue identities in the explicitly selected route population. Pull requests are excluded. Authored routes prove authorship; participation and repository routes do not.

issue_dependency_count.comment: Canonical blocking/blocked Issue pairs shared across both API directions. Direction means the blocking issue must be resolved before the blocked issue; no transitive closure or cycles are inferred.

issue_event_count.comment: Canonical issue event IDs across repository, issue-specific and exact routes; event actors are distinct from issue authors and assignment subjects.

issue_field_count.comment: Selected issue_fields rows at the declared identity grain.

issue_field_value_count.comment: Returned issue/field assignments, including explicit NULL values; not field definition count.

issue_related_membership_count.comment: Directed source/related Issue observations returned by the API. A symmetric relationship retrieved from both endpoints produces two directed observations; this is not an undirected distinct-edge count.

issue_repository_count.comment: Distinct known repository identities represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across dates/categories; unknown repository context is excluded.

issue_subissue_membership_count.comment: Canonical parent/child Issue pairs shared across parent lookup and sub-issue collection. A parent or child may be in another repository. This counts direct edges, not all descendants or distinct issue identities.

issue_suggestion_count.comment: Agent-proposed issue changes in all lifecycle states unless a state filter is supplied; proposals are not applied changes.

issue_timeline_entry_count.comment: Returned mixed timeline observations, not distinct issue events, comments, reviews or commits. Retrieval-local ordinals preserve occurrences across pages.

issue_type_count.comment: Selected issue_types rows at the declared identity grain.

label_count.comment: Current label definitions, including unused labels; not issue or pull-request label assignments.

labeled_pull_request_count.comment: Current PR-label memberships; different labels may share a name, so use label_id for identity. Distinct parents represented by the selected memberships; excludes parents with no returned memberships. Never sum this count across membership groups.

latest_approved_reviewer_count.comment: PR/reviewer pairs whose latest submitted record is APPROVED; not distinct people across PRs and not GitHub merge eligibility.

latest_reviewer_review_count.comment: PR/reviewer pairs with an observed submitted review; the latest record is selected before this count.

license_count.comment: Canonical catalog records selected by listing or exact key; list entries are hydrated to the same complete detail shape.

mean_first_review_hours.comment: Equal weight per reviewed PR; averages the first review latency, not all review records. Unreviewed PRs are excluded.

median_first_review_hours.comment: Median first-review latency across reviewed PRs; one observation per PR.

median_merge_hours.comment: Exact continuous median elapsed UTC hours from PR creation to merge. NULL for an empty merged cohort; independent of review multiplicity.

median_release_asset_size_bytes.comment: Exact median current byte size across selected assets, including zero-byte open uploads.

median_workflow_job_execution_hours.comment: Median elapsed job execution hours for completed, timestamped jobs; each job contributes once, including prior attempts.

merged_prs.comment: PRs with a merge timestamp, including bots and draft waiting time.

merged_pull_request_check_count.comment: Merge-check observations with the declared merged HTTP response.

milestone_closed_work_item_count.comment: Sum API-reported current closed milestone work items; not historical throughput.

milestone_count.comment: Current repository milestone identities, including open and closed states unless explicitly filtered.

milestone_open_work_item_count.comment: Sum API-reported current open milestone work items, which can include pull requests.

monthly_pr_total.comment: Visible authored PR total for this user and UTC creation month across all repository groups in the selected population.

monthly_repository_pr_share.comment: Repository share of a user's visible authored PRs in a UTC creation month. Denominator is formed before QUALIFY or output LIMIT; no claim about invisible repositories or contribution quality.

monthly_user_pr_rank.comment: Dense rank of selected users by observed authored-PR count in each UTC creation month. Ties share rank; users with no observed PRs are absent. This is activity volume, not performance or impact.

notification_count.comment: Current caller-qualified notification threads, including read and unread entries.

notification_subscription_observation_co.comment: Caller/thread subscription snapshots hydrated from the selected canonical notification population.

numeric_project_field_value_count.comment: Assigned ProjectV2ItemFieldNumberValue records with non-NULL number.

observed_agent_session_count.comment: Number of observed nested sessions; missing session arrays remain unknown, while empty arrays count zero.

offered_codespace_cpu_count.comment: Sum of offered cores across options, not allocated machine cores.

open_pull_request_stack_count.comment: Stacks explicitly containing an open PR.

open_security_campaign_count.comment: Selected security_campaigns rows at the declared entity grain. Restricted to state=open.

organization_count.comment: Selected organization identities, including organizations with no visible members, teams or repositories.

organization_invitation_count.comment: Selected organization_invitations rows at their declared qualified grain.

organization_invitation_team_count.comment: Selected organization_invitation_teams rows at the declared identity grain.

organization_member_count.comment: Active visible organization/account relationships. Pending invitations are retained as membership records but excluded from this active member count.

organization_membership_check_count.comment: Selected membership visibility observations including unconfirmed results.

organization_membership_record_count.comment: Selected active or pending organization membership records at organization/account grain.

organization_outside_collaborator_count.comment: Selected organization_outside_collaborators rows at the declared identity grain.

organization_reported_active_cache_count.comment: Organization-reported active cache count, independent from repository inventory.

p90_first_review_hours.comment: Continuous 90th percentile of first-review latency across reviewed PRs; one observation per PR.

package_count.comment: Selected canonical packages; registry and owner scopes remain explicit.

package_version_count.comment: Enumerated selected package version records, including deleted versions only where explicitly requested or returned by lookup.

pages_build_count.comment: Distinct repository/build-URL records from the selected all/latest/exact-ID population; API retention bounds are preserved.

pages_build_reported_duration.comment: Sum of upstream reported duration values for distinct selected builds. The pinned schema does not specify a duration unit; no seconds/milliseconds conversion is inferred.

pages_deployment_status_count.comment: Status lookup observations, not a complete Pages deployment population or distinct deployments across aliases.

pages_site_count.comment: Configured Pages site snapshots retrieved successfully for the selected repositories; not a count of every repository hosting status.

pending_artifact_metadata_job_count.comment: Selected artifact metadata jobs whose observed lifecycle status is pending.

pending_deployment_review_count.comment: Review occurrences reporting pending with comments.

pending_deployment_reviewer_count.comment: Configured user/team reviewer options, not approvals or all-required reviewers.

pending_deployment_status_count.comment: Status events in a nonterminal pending, queued or in-progress state.

pending_deployment_wait_minutes.comment: Sum of configured wait durations in minutes; not elapsed waiting time.

pending_organization_membership_count.comment: Selected organization memberships still pending acceptance; not active organization members.

pending_team_membership_count.comment: Selected pending team membership records, excluding active effective members.

pr_first_review_at.comment: Earliest eligible review submission instant. Missing timestamps and pending states are excluded.
pr_first_review_at.population: pull_request_reviews.submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND pull_request_reviews.state IN ('APPROVED', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'COMMENTED', 'DISMISSED')

pr_first_review_hours.comment: Earliest submitted review latency per selected PR group; use first_review_prs for a distribution with one observation per PR.
pr_first_review_hours.population: pull_request_reviews.submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND pull_request_reviews.state IN ('APPROVED', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'COMMENTED', 'DISMISSED')

prerelease_count.comment: Selected releases marked prerelease, independently of draft status.

primary_user_email_count.comment: Selected user_emails observations satisfying the explicitly stated measure predicate.

processing_artifact_metadata_job_count.comment: Selected artifact metadata jobs whose observed lifecycle status is processing.

production_deployment_count.comment: Deployment records explicitly marked production; missing classification is not false.

project_count.comment: Visible Projects v2 identities across selected owners and project numbers.

project_field_count.comment: Field definitions in selected projects, including fields with no assigned values.

project_field_label_count.comment: Visible item/field/member associations; not distinct people, labels, reviewers or PRs across items.

project_field_pull_request_count.comment: Visible item/field/member associations; not distinct people, labels, reviewers or PRs across items.

project_field_reviewer_count.comment: Visible item/field/member associations; not distinct people, labels, reviewers or PRs across items.

project_field_user_count.comment: Visible item/field/member associations; not distinct people, labels, reviewers or PRs across items.

project_field_value_count.comment: Assigned project-item/field pairs. Multi-valued labels/users/reviewers/PRs still count as one field value.

project_issue_item_count.comment: Project items whose content type is ISSUE.

project_item_count.comment: Project item identities, not distinct content issues or PRs. The same content in two projects counts twice.

project_pull_request_item_count.comment: Project items whose content type is PULL_REQUEST.

protected_branch_environment_count.comment: Environments explicitly restricted to protected branches.

public_gist_count.comment: Selected current gists explicitly marked public.

published_release_count.comment: Selected release records with a publication instant, including prereleases.

pull_request_active_days.comment: Distinct UTC creation dates represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across repositories and other overlapping groups; inactive dates contribute zero.

pull_request_assignee_membership_count.comment: Current PR-assignee memberships; assignment does not establish authorship, review or team contribution. Counts membership pairs; one parent can contribute to several memberships.

pull_request_count.comment: All selected open and closed PR records; each PR counts once regardless of reviews.

pull_request_detail_observation_count.comment: Selected PRs retrieved through a full-response route with reported detail counters. List-only observations are excluded.

pull_request_file_additions.comment: Added lines in current PR file diffs.

pull_request_file_changes.comment: Total reported changed lines, not distinct repository lines across PRs.

pull_request_file_count.comment: Net changed file paths across selected pull requests.

pull_request_file_deletions.comment: Deleted lines in current PR file diffs.

pull_request_label_membership_count.comment: Current PR-label memberships; different labels may share a name, so use label_id for identity. Counts membership pairs; one parent can contribute to several memberships.

pull_request_reported_additions.comment: Sum of reported added lines on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.

pull_request_reported_changed_file_count.comment: Sum of reported changed files on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.

pull_request_reported_comment_count.comment: Sum of reported issue comments on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.

pull_request_reported_commit_count.comment: Sum of reported included commits on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.

pull_request_reported_deletions.comment: Sum of reported deleted lines on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.

pull_request_reported_review_comment_cou.comment: Sum of reported review comments on selected full PR responses; unavailable list observations are NULL. Current PR snapshots, not event counts in a date window; shared commits/files may occur in multiple PRs.

pull_request_repository_count.comment: Distinct known repository identities represented by selected visible records. Non-additive across dates/categories; unknown repository context is excluded.

pull_request_review_comment_count.comment: Visible diff review comments, separate from issue conversation comments.

push_bypass_approved_count.comment: Push bypass approved count. Counts the declared entity grain.

push_bypass_cancelled_count.comment: Push bypass cancelled count. Counts the declared entity grain.

push_bypass_completed_count.comment: Push bypass completed count. Counts the declared entity grain.

push_bypass_deleted_count.comment: Push bypass deleted count. Counts the declared entity grain.

push_bypass_denied_count.comment: Push bypass denied count. Counts the declared entity grain.

push_bypass_expired_count.comment: Push bypass expired count. Counts the declared entity grain.

push_bypass_open_count.comment: Push bypass open count. Counts the declared entity grain.

push_bypass_pending_count.comment: Push bypass pending count. Counts the declared entity grain.

push_bypass_request_count.comment: Push bypass request count. Counts the declared entity grain.

push_bypass_response_count.comment: Count of observed reviewer responses; requester and reviewer roles remain distinct.

queued_agent_task_count.comment: Tasks whose current API state is queued.

reaction_count.comment: Current reaction identities attached to the selected subject, not distinct actors, parent records or historical reaction events.

reaction_reactor_count.comment: Distinct known reacting account identities. Deleted or unavailable reactors are excluded; non-additive across subjects and reaction symbols.

reaction_thumbsdown_count.comment: Current -1 reactions only. Releases do not support this reaction symbol in the pinned API.

reaction_thumbsup_count.comment: Current +1 reactions only; no sentiment interpretation is assigned to other symbols.

reaction_unknown_reactor_count.comment: Reaction rows whose reacting account ID is unavailable; these still contribute to reaction_count.

ready_prebuild_machine_option_count.comment: Machine options reporting a ready prebuild.

release_asset_content_count.comment: Retrieved representation rows, including explicitly pending rows.

release_asset_content_median_bytes.comment: Median downloaded byte length; pending responses have zero downloaded bytes.

release_asset_count.comment: Current release asset metadata records at repository/asset identity; not Actions artifacts and not historical uploads.

release_asset_download_count.comment: Sum of lifetime download counters observed now for distinct selected assets; not downloads during the query date range.

release_asset_size_bytes.comment: Sum of current byte sizes over distinct selected assets; not cumulative transfer volume.

release_count.comment: Selected release records, including visible drafts and prereleases; one observation per stable repository/release identity.

release_publication_day_count.comment: Distinct UTC dates with publication among selected releases; NULL draft publication dates are excluded and counts are non-additive across repositories.

release_reported_mention_count.comment: Sum of current mention counters reported for selected releases. Missing observations remain NULL; not mentions during a publication date range.

release_reported_reaction_count.comment: Sum of current reaction counters reported for selected releases. Missing observations remain NULL; not reaction creation events during a publication date range.

reported_active_cache_bytes.comment: Sum of API-reported active cache bytes; not billing storage or retention policy.

reported_active_cache_count.comment: Sum of API-reported active cache counters.

reported_agent_session_count.comment: Sum of API-reported session counters, which may differ from nested session observations.

reported_concurrency_member_count.comment: API-reported queue member counters for the selected observations; not inferred from nested rows.

reported_contributor_commit_count.comment: Sum of cached API contribution counters; not independently enumerated commit count.

reported_package_version_count.comment: Sum of current API-reported package version counters, distinct from enumerated selected version records.

repositories_with_topic_count.comment: Distinct repositories represented by the selected topic memberships; excludes empty parents and is non-additive across overlapping topics.

repository_archives_count.comment: Retrieved representation rows, including explicitly pending rows.

repository_archives_median_bytes.comment: Median downloaded byte length; pending responses have zero downloaded bytes.

repository_assignee_count.comment: Repository/user eligibility memberships; the same user eligible in two repositories contributes two memberships.

repository_change_count.comment: Distinct repository-qualified change records in the selected filtered history.

repository_clone_bucket_event_count.comment: Reported events summed over selected non-overlapping buckets of one requested aggregation.

repository_clone_bucket_unique_max.comment: Maximum single bucket unique count; not distinct people across buckets.

repository_clone_count.comment: Reported clone events summed across disjoint selected repositories within the current response window.

repository_clone_traffic_buckets_count.comment: Returned traffic buckets, not repositories or unique people.

repository_clone_unique_max.comment: Maximum repository-window unique clone count; not global distinct people and not a sum of bucket uniques.

repository_code_frequency_additions.comment: Reported additions in distinct selected weekly tuples.

repository_code_frequency_signed_deletio.comment: Signed upstream deletion values, with no sign inversion.

repository_code_frequency_week_count.comment: Returned repository code frequency observations; not an independent count of Git commits or users.

repository_commit_activity_commit_count.comment: Upstream commit totals for distinct returned weeks.

repository_commit_activity_week_count.comment: Returned repository commit activity observations; not an independent count of Git commits or users.

repository_commit_punch_card_bucket_coun.comment: Returned repository commit punch card observations; not an independent count of Git commits or users.

repository_commit_punch_card_commit_coun.comment: Reported commits summed over disjoint day/hour buckets in the selected repositories.

repository_content_object_count.comment: Successfully retrieved content objects at repository/path/SHA grain, not recursive file counts.

repository_content_reported_size_bytes.comment: Reported size of the distinct selected content objects. Directory size does not represent recursively contained bytes; this is not downloaded payload size.

repository_contributor_observation_count.comment: Returned contributor observations in the selected anonymous population.

repository_contributor_statistics_commit.comment: Reported contributor commit totals within the selected repository snapshots; not distinct global commits.

repository_contributor_statistics_observ.comment: Returned repository contributor statistics observations; not an independent count of Git commits or users.

repository_count.comment: Visible repository entities, including repositories with no PRs or labels.

repository_current_stars.comment: Sum over distinct selected repositories in the current snapshot.

repository_hash_observation_count.comment: Repositories with an observed object hash algorithm.

repository_language_bytes.comment: GitHub reported language bytes over the selected repository/language entries.

repository_language_count.comment: Repository/language entries; the same language in two repositories counts twice.

repository_license_file_bytes.comment: Upstream file byte sizes for selected repository/path/blob snapshots; not the encoded string length.

repository_license_file_count.comment: Selected repository license files, including files with no recognized catalog license classification.

repository_participation_observation_cou.comment: Returned repository participation statistics observations; not an independent count of Git commits or users.

repository_permission_observation_count.comment: Returned effective permission observations, including none.

repository_property_definition_count.comment: Selected repository_property_definitions rows at the declared identity grain.

repository_property_value_count.comment: Property assignments, including explicitly null values.

repository_star_count.comment: Current repository/account relationships, with the same grain from repository and account retrieval directions. Not historical follow/unfollow events.

repository_star_observation_count.comment: Current caller/requested repository star-status observations. The requested owner/name is an observation locator, not a stable renamed repository identity.

repository_star_week_count.comment: Selected repository/week buckets, including zero-count weeks.

repository_subscription_observation_coun.comment: Caller/repository subscription snapshots returned successfully; not an inference about inaccessible repositories.

repository_tag_count.comment: Current tag names returned by repository tag listing, including annotated and lightweight tags; distinct from release count.

repository_top_paths_count.comment: Returned top-10 paths observations, not all paths.

repository_top_paths_event_count.comment: Events attributed to the returned top-10 paths only, not all repository traffic.

repository_top_paths_unique_max.comment: Maximum unique count for one returned path; not a distinct visitor total.

repository_top_referrers_count.comment: Returned top-10 referrers observations, not all referrers.

repository_top_referrers_event_count.comment: Events attributed to the returned top-10 referrers only, not all repository traffic.

repository_top_referrers_unique_max.comment: Maximum unique count for one returned referrer; not a distinct visitor total.

repository_topic_membership_count.comment: Current repository/topic membership pairs in the complete selected endpoint population.

repository_view_bucket_event_count.comment: Reported events summed over selected non-overlapping buckets of one requested aggregation.

repository_view_bucket_unique_max.comment: Maximum single bucket unique count; not distinct people across buckets.

repository_view_count.comment: Reported view events summed across disjoint selected repositories within the current response window.

repository_view_traffic_buckets_count.comment: Returned traffic buckets, not repositories or unique people.

repository_view_unique_max.comment: Maximum repository-window unique view count; not global distinct people and not a sum of bucket uniques.

repository_watcher_count.comment: Current repository/account relationships, with the same grain from repository and account retrieval directions. Not historical follow/unfollow events.

repository_weekly_stars_created.comment: Reported stars created in the selected distinct repository/week buckets.

requested_team_review_count.comment: Outstanding PR/team review-request memberships; teams are not individual reviewer accounts.

review_latest_rank.comment: Latest submitted review per PR and reviewer, ordered by instant and then greatest review ID for deterministic timestamp ties.

review_record_count.comment: All returned review records, including pending records; used before the explicit submitted-review stage filter.

review_record_login.comment: Reviewer login at unique review-record grain; the stable numeric reviewer ID controls identity.

review_record_state.comment: Review state at the unique review-record grain; used only to carry its value into the submitted-review stage.

review_request_population_count.comment: Selected per-PR current reviewer-request populations, including empty lists.

reviewed_environment_association_count.comment: Review/environment associations; one review can refer to multiple environments.

reviewed_pr_count.comment: PRs with at least one submitted, timestamped review. Each PR contributes once regardless of review count.

rule_evaluation_count.comment: Count of observed typed rule evaluations; a missing list provides no observed evaluations.

rule_suite_bypass_count.comment: Rule suite bypass count. Counts the declared entity grain.

rule_suite_count.comment: Rule suite count. Counts the declared entity grain.

rule_suite_fail_count.comment: Rule suite fail count. Counts the declared entity grain.

rule_suite_pass_count.comment: Rule suite pass count. Counts the declared entity grain.

sbom_package_entry_count.comment: Declared package entries in selected documents, including the root repository package; not distinct registry packages.

sbom_relationship_entry_count.comment: SPDX relationship entries where reported; absent relationship data remains NULL.

search_account_hit_count.comment: Query-qualified users hits in one complete API response population, not a count of all GitHub users.

search_account_hit_max_score.comment: Maximum upstream relevance score in this selected query population; scores are not additive and are not comparable across different query kinds or invocations.

search_code_hit_count.comment: Query-qualified code hits in one complete API response population, not a count of all GitHub code.

search_code_hit_max_score.comment: Maximum upstream relevance score in this selected query population; scores are not additive and are not comparable across different query kinds or invocations.

search_commit_hit_count.comment: Query-qualified commits hits in one complete API response population, not a count of all GitHub commits.

search_commit_hit_max_score.comment: Maximum upstream relevance score in this selected query population; scores are not additive and are not comparable across different query kinds or invocations.

search_issue_hit_count.comment: Query-qualified issues hits in one complete API response population, not a count of all GitHub issues.

search_issue_hit_max_score.comment: Maximum upstream relevance score in this selected query population; scores are not additive and are not comparable across different query kinds or invocations.

search_label_hit_count.comment: Query-qualified labels hits in one complete API response population, not a count of all GitHub labels.

search_label_hit_max_score.comment: Maximum upstream relevance score in this selected query population; scores are not additive and are not comparable across different query kinds or invocations.

search_repository_hit_count.comment: Query-qualified repositories hits in one complete API response population, not a count of all GitHub repositories.

search_repository_hit_max_score.comment: Maximum upstream relevance score in this selected query population; scores are not additive and are not comparable across different query kinds or invocations.

search_topic_hit_count.comment: Query-qualified topics hits in one complete API response population, not a count of all GitHub topics.

search_topic_hit_max_score.comment: Maximum upstream relevance score in this selected query population; scores are not additive and are not comparable across different query kinds or invocations.

secret_scanning_active_alert_count.comment: Latest observed credential validity is active, independent of alert lifecycle.

secret_scanning_alert_count.comment: Distinct repository-qualified secret alerts, not distinct credentials across repositories.

secret_scanning_bypass_approved_count.comment: Requests currently approved; approval is not equivalent to a completed bypass or resolved alert.

secret_scanning_bypass_request_count.comment: Delegated bypass requests in the selected API lookback window, default month; not all historical requests.

secret_scanning_bypassed_alert_count.comment: Alerts explicitly marked as caused by a push-protection bypass. Unknown is not false.

secret_scanning_custom_pattern_count.comment: Pattern identities within explicit selected scope, not globally deduplicated inherited definitions.

secret_scanning_dismissal_approved_count.comment: Requests currently approved; approval is not equivalent to a completed bypass or resolved alert.

secret_scanning_dismissal_request_count.comment: Delegated dismissal requests in the selected API lookback window, default month; not all historical requests.

secret_scanning_location_count.comment: Returned location occurrences, including all pages. No durable server location ID exists; retrieval-local ordinal preserves distinct occurrences without inventing cross-snapshot identity.

secret_scanning_open_alert_count.comment: Alerts whose observed lifecycle state is open.

secret_scanning_pattern_configuration_co.comment: Selected organization configuration snapshots, not patterns, executions or alerts.

secret_scanning_protected_pattern_count.comment: Selected scoped custom patterns with push protection enabled.

secret_scanning_resolved_alert_count.comment: Resolved alerts; resolution alone does not establish revoked or inactive credentials.

secret_scanning_scan_snapshot_count.comment: Repositories with a retrieved latest-scan snapshot, not historical scan executions.

security_campaign_closed_alert_occurrenc.comment: Sum of reported campaign alert memberships; alerts can belong to more than one campaign. Missing statistics remain unknown.

security_campaign_count.comment: Selected security_campaigns rows at the declared entity grain.

security_campaign_in_progress_alert_occu.comment: Sum of reported campaign alert memberships; alerts can belong to more than one campaign. Missing statistics remain unknown.

security_campaign_open_alert_occurrences.comment: Sum of reported campaign alert memberships; alerts can belong to more than one campaign. Missing statistics remain unknown.

stack_pull_request_membership_count.comment: Ordered stack/PR memberships in selected stacks, not a count of all repository PRs.

starred_gist_observation_count.comment: Observations for which GitHub returned the documented starred status. A 404 does not prove target existence or visibility.

starred_repository_observation_count.comment: The documented affirmative star status; 404 does not prove target existence or visibility.

submitted_review_count.comment: Review records whose current state is APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, COMMENTED or DISMISSED. Pending reviews are excluded; repeated submissions by one reviewer count separately.

submitted_review_state.comment: Submitted state at a unique review ID, retained for latest-review selection.

submitted_reviewer_login.comment: Reviewer login at a unique submitted review ID; not the PR author.

subscribed_notification_count.comment: Selected thread subscription snapshots explicitly marked subscribed.

successful_check_run_count.comment: Runs whose current conclusion is success.

successful_deployment_status_count.comment: Status events reporting success, not distinct successful deployments.

successful_pages_build_count.comment: Selected build records explicitly marked built.

successful_pages_deployment_status_count.comment: Lookup observations whose returned state is succeed.

team_count.comment: Current visible team identities in the selected organization, including empty teams.

team_membership_check_count.comment: Selected team_membership_checks rows at their declared qualified grain.

team_membership_count.comment: Active effective team/account relationships, including inherited members; pending invitations are excluded.

team_membership_record_count.comment: Selected active and pending team/account membership records.

team_repository_access_count.comment: Selected team_repository_access rows at their declared qualified grain.

team_repository_permission_check_count.comment: Selected team_repository_permission_checks rows at their declared qualified grain.

timed_out_agent_task_count.comment: Tasks whose current API state is timed_out.

truncated_gist_count.comment: Selected gist snapshots flagged truncated by GitHub; content is never advertised as fully downloaded.

unconfirmed_organization_membership_chec.comment: Membership not confirmed under the explicitly selected endpoint visibility; no claim about hidden private membership.

unconfirmed_repository_collaborator_coun.comment: Checks returning404; not a claim of proven absence under every credential.

unconfirmed_team_membership_check_count.comment: Selected status observations; unconfirmed visibility does not establish absence of private access.

unconfirmed_team_repository_permission_c.comment: Selected status observations; unconfirmed visibility does not establish absence of private access.

unfinished_check_run_count.comment: Runs with no conclusion, including queued and in-progress runs.

unmerged_pull_request_check_count.comment: Merge-check observations with the declared not-merged HTTP response.

unread_notification_count.comment: Selected caller notification threads explicitly marked unread.

uploaded_release_asset_count.comment: Current assets whose upload state is uploaded; open assets are retained in release_asset_count.

user_context_observation_count.comment: Selected user_context_observations rows at the declared entity grain.

user_count.comment: Selected personal user accounts, including users with no visible authored PRs.

user_email_count.comment: Selected user_emails rows at the declared entity grain.

user_follow_check_count.comment: Selected user_follow_checks rows at the declared entity grain.

user_follow_relationship_count.comment: Selected user_follow_relationships rows at the declared entity grain.

user_social_account_count.comment: Selected user_social_accounts rows at the declared entity grain.

verified_user_email_count.comment: Selected user_emails observations satisfying the explicitly stated measure predicate.

waiting_for_user_agent_task_count.comment: Tasks whose current API state is waiting_for_user.

workflow_artifact_archives_count.comment: Retrieved representation rows, including explicitly pending rows.

workflow_artifact_archives_median_bytes.comment: Median downloaded byte length; pending responses have zero downloaded bytes.

workflow_artifact_bytes.comment: Sum of reported bytes for selected visible artifacts, including expired artifacts if returned; not retained storage usage or billing.

workflow_artifact_count.comment: Visible Actions artifact metadata, distinct from release assets. Expired artifacts remain if returned; deleted artifacts are absent. Artifact names are not identities and run linkage may be NULL. Repository selection includes artifacts without discoverable runs; workflow and run selections follow their listing endpoints. No attempt-specific artifact population is claimed. Analytical enrichment follows the known repository directly, preserving artifacts with no discoverable run. Run identity and bidirectional run retrieval remain explicit, but artifact aggregation by attributes from the run or workflow entities is not approved because it would introduce a competing analytical path and can lose orphan artifacts.

workflow_attempt_log_archives_count.comment: Retrieved representation rows, including explicitly pending rows.

workflow_attempt_log_archives_median_byt.comment: Median downloaded byte length; pending responses have zero downloaded bytes.

workflow_count.comment: Visible workflow definitions, including inactive workflows returned by GitHub; one row per stable workflow ID.

workflow_deployment_review_count.comment: Returned review-log occurrences; repeated identical reviews remain distinct.

workflow_job_cancelled_count.comment: Visible job executions at stable job-ID grain. Rerun jobs count separately; no default latest-attempt filter. Steps and runner labels are embedded lists, not job multipliers. Counts records whose conclusion equals cancelled; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

workflow_job_count.comment: Visible job executions at stable job-ID grain. Rerun jobs count separately; no default latest-attempt filter. Steps and runner labels are embedded lists, not job multipliers.

workflow_job_failure_count.comment: Visible job executions at stable job-ID grain. Rerun jobs count separately; no default latest-attempt filter. Steps and runner labels are embedded lists, not job multipliers. Counts records whose conclusion equals failure; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

workflow_job_logs_count.comment: Retrieved representation rows, including explicitly pending rows.

workflow_job_logs_median_bytes.comment: Median downloaded byte length; pending responses have zero downloaded bytes.

workflow_job_step_count.comment: Steps explicitly returned in selected job responses, identified by job ID and step number. Missing step lists are not fabricated steps and do not establish zero configured steps.

workflow_job_step_failure_count.comment: Returned steps whose conclusion is failure, at job ID and step number grain.

workflow_job_success_count.comment: Visible job executions at stable job-ID grain. Rerun jobs count separately; no default latest-attempt filter. Steps and runner labels are embedded lists, not job multipliers. Counts records whose conclusion equals success; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

workflow_run_attempt_cancelled_count.comment: Only explicitly selected workflow run attempts, keyed by run ID and attempt number; no exhaustive attempt-history claim. Counts records whose conclusion equals cancelled; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

workflow_run_attempt_count.comment: Only explicitly selected workflow run attempts, keyed by run ID and attempt number; no exhaustive attempt-history claim.

workflow_run_attempt_failure_count.comment: Only explicitly selected workflow run attempts, keyed by run ID and attempt number; no exhaustive attempt-history claim. Counts records whose conclusion equals failure; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

workflow_run_attempt_success_count.comment: Only explicitly selected workflow run attempts, keyed by run ID and attempt number; no exhaustive attempt-history claim. Counts records whose conclusion equals success; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

workflow_run_cancelled_count.comment: Visible workflow run identities. Reruns update the same run; status, conclusion and run_started_at describe the latest attempt. Actor and triggering actor are distinct roles, not commit authors. Counts records whose conclusion equals cancelled; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

workflow_run_concurrency_group_count.comment: Run/group configuration memberships, including empty groups.

workflow_run_concurrency_member_count.comment: Current run-scoped leases returned for configured group memberships.

workflow_run_count.comment: Visible workflow run identities. Reruns update the same run; status, conclusion and run_started_at describe the latest attempt. Actor and triggering actor are distinct roles, not commit authors.

workflow_run_failure_count.comment: Visible workflow run identities. Reruns update the same run; status, conclusion and run_started_at describe the latest attempt. Actor and triggering actor are distinct roles, not commit authors. Counts records whose conclusion equals failure; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

workflow_run_log_archives_count.comment: Retrieved representation rows, including explicitly pending rows.

workflow_run_log_archives_median_bytes.comment: Median downloaded byte length; pending responses have zero downloaded bytes.

workflow_run_success_count.comment: Visible workflow run identities. Reruns update the same run; status, conclusion and run_started_at describe the latest attempt. Actor and triggering actor are distinct roles, not commit authors. Counts records whose conclusion equals success; pending or unknown outcomes are excluded.

workflow_step_logs_count.comment: Retrieved representation rows, including explicitly pending rows.

workflow_step_logs_median_bytes.comment: Median downloaded byte length; pending responses have zero downloaded bytes.

activity_view.comment: Activity feed population: public global feed, performed or performed_public for a user, received or received_public for a user, network for a repository, or organization_authenticated for an authenticated user and organization. Allowed values: ["public", "performed", "performed_public", "received", "received_public", "network", "organization_authenticated"]. Validated before retrieval.

advisory_state.comment: Optional repository advisory state filter; omission retains all visible states. Allowed values: ["triage", "draft", "published", "closed"]. Validated before retrieval.

advisory_type.comment: Explicit global advisory population, including malware and unreviewed records when selected. Allowed values: ["reviewed", "unreviewed", "malware"]. Validated before retrieval.

agent_task_archived.comment: Select archived tasks when true, or active non-archived tasks when false or omitted.

agent_task_creator_ids.comment: Repository task creator user IDs; serialized as repeated creator_id query parameters.

agent_task_direction.comment: API task ordering direction; ordering does not limit the fully paginated population. Allowed values: ["asc", "desc"]. Validated before retrieval.

agent_task_id.comment: Exact globally unique agent task identifier; repository optionally selects the repository-specific lookup endpoint.

agent_task_since.comment: Only tasks updated at or after this instant.

agent_task_sort.comment: API task ordering field; ordering does not limit the fully paginated population. Allowed values: ["updated_at", "created_at"]. Validated before retrieval.

agent_task_states.comment: Comma-separated task states to select; omitted means any state within the chosen archived population.

ahead_of_job_id.comment: Queue prefix through this workflow job, including the selected job; requires repository and concurrency_group. Mutually exclusive with ahead_of_run_id.

ahead_of_run_id.comment: Queue prefix through this workflow run, including the selected run; requires repository and concurrency_group. Mutually exclusive with ahead_of_job_id.

artifact_cluster.comment: Artifact-metadata cluster identifier; the pinned API accepts letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.

artifact_metadata_job_id.comment: Exact previously-created artifact metadata cluster job ID; this route only observes the job.

artifact_subject_digest.comment: SHA256 artifact metadata subject digest in sha256: followed by64lowercase hexadecimal digits.

assignee_login.comment: User login whose issue-assignment eligibility is observed; distinct from the current assigned users.

attempt_number.comment: One explicit attempt number, starting at one; this selector does not enumerate attempts.

attestation_predicate_type.comment: Optional attestation predicate filter: provenance, sbom, release or a custom predicate type.

attestation_subject_digest.comment: Attestation subject SHA256 digest in sha256:HEX_DIGEST form.

attested_repositories.comment: Select repositories with at least one attested artifact, optionally filtered by attestation predicate. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

authenticated_user.comment: Select the authenticated personal account using GitHub /user endpoints; never infer the account from ambient login names. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

blob_sha.comment: Exact Git blob object SHA. Encoded content is preserved with its explicit encoding.

branch_name.comment: Exact repository branch name, including slash-containing names.

branch_protected.comment: Optional protected-branch selector; omitted includes protected and unprotected branches.

bypass_repository_name.comment: Optional repository name within the selected organization when listing push-rule bypass requests.

bypass_request_number.comment: Repository-local number of one push rule bypass request.

bypass_request_status.comment: Requested API status filter; response statuses are preserved independently. Allowed values: ["completed", "cancelled", "approved", "expired", "deleted", "denied", "open", "all"]. Validated before retrieval.

bypass_requester.comment: Login of the user who requested the push-rule bypass.

bypass_reviewer.comment: Login of a delegated reviewer who responded to the bypass request.

bypass_time_period.comment: Rolling time window of bypass requests; omission uses the API default day. Allowed values: ["hour", "day", "week", "month"]. Validated before retrieval.

cache_key.comment: Optional cache key or key prefix, using the API key filter.

cache_ref.comment: Optional full Git reference selecting Actions cache entries.

check_run_node_id.comment: Exact GraphQL CheckRun node ID. Selects the explicit enriched route and requires the matching repository.

check_suite_node_id.comment: Exact GraphQL CheckSuite node ID. Selects the explicit enriched route and requires the matching repository.

code_quality_finding_number.comment: Repository-local code-quality finding number; distinct from security alert numbers.

code_quality_finding_state.comment: Optional code-quality finding state; omission includes all visible states. Allowed values: ["open", "dismissed"]. Validated before retrieval.

code_scanning_alert_number.comment: Repository-local code scanning alert number. Distinct from issue and pull-request numbers.

code_scanning_analysis_id.comment: Exact code scanning analysis ID within the selected repository.

code_scanning_assignees.comment: Optional comma-separated alert assignee logins, * for any assignee or none for unassigned alerts.

code_scanning_dismissal_period.comment: Dismissal-request lookback window: hour, day, week or month. Omission uses the API month default; this is not all historical requests.

code_scanning_dismissal_requester.comment: Optional login of the user requesting alert dismissal, distinct from reviewers.

code_scanning_dismissal_reviewer.comment: Optional login of a dismissal-request reviewer, distinct from the requester.

code_scanning_dismissal_status.comment: Optional dismissal-request filter: open, approved, expired, denied or all. The response status uses pending for an open request.

code_scanning_pr.comment: Optional pull-request number restricting code scanning alert, instance or analysis discovery.

code_scanning_ref.comment: Optional branch or pull-request Git ref selecting alerts, instances or analyses. Alert discovery is filtered by this ref; canonical alert metadata is hydrated from the alert object endpoint.

code_scanning_sarif_id.comment: Exact SARIF upload ID; selects upload status or analyses belonging to this upload.

code_scanning_severity.comment: Optional alert discovery severity: critical, high, medium, low, warning, note or error. Security severity and rule diagnostic severity remain distinct output fields.

code_scanning_state.comment: Optional alert discovery state: open, closed, dismissed or fixed. Omission includes every state.

code_scanning_tool_guid.comment: Optional analysis tool GUID; mutually exclusive with the tool name selector at the GitHub API.

code_scanning_tool_name.comment: Optional analysis tool name; the GitHub API rejects simultaneous tool name and tool GUID selectors.

codeowners_ref.comment: Branch, tag or commit selecting the CODEOWNERS version; omitted means the repository default branch.

codeql_database_language.comment: Exact CodeQL database language; retrieves the current uploaded database for that language.

codeql_target_repository.comment: Target repository as owner/name within the selected variant analysis; repository remains the controller repository.

codeql_variant_analysis_id.comment: Exact CodeQL variant analysis ID in the selected controller repository; no enumeration endpoint exists.

codespace_client_ip.comment: Client IP used by GitHub to resolve location-sensitive Codespaces availability and defaults.

codespace_export_id.comment: Codespace export selector: an export ID or latest. The latest alias is a current observation, not a durable export identity.

codespace_name.comment: Exact generated Codespace name, used by the authenticated-user Codespaces API.

codespace_ref.comment: Git branch or commit reference for Codespaces availability, creation defaults or devcontainer permission checks.

codespace_repository_id.comment: Optional numeric repository filter for the authenticated user Codespaces listing.

commit_author.comment: Optional GitHub login or Git email restricting original commit authorship; distinct from committer.

commit_comment_id.comment: Exact numeric repository commit-comment identity, distinct from issue and review comment IDs.

commit_comment_sha.comment: Exact commit SHA whose comments are selected; distinct from author or committer identity.

commit_committer.comment: Optional GitHub login or Git email restricting the committer; distinct from original author.

commit_comparison.comment: Comparison selection BASE...HEAD, including supported fork-qualified references. Mutable refs resolve at request time; this string identifies the selected comparison, not an immutable commit.

commit_history_ref.comment: Optional branch, tag or SHA whose reachable commit history is listed. Omission selects the repository default branch, not every branch or unreachable commit.

commit_path.comment: Optional file path restricting the GitHub commit history endpoint.

commit_ref.comment: Commit SHA, branch or tag resolved to one canonical commit at request time.

commit_since.comment: Optional inclusive UTC-aware commit history lower timestamp bound accepted by GitHub.

commit_status_population.comment: Select the latest status for each context from the combined-status endpoint. Omission selects the complete status event history for the supplied ref. Allowed values: ["latest"]. Validated before retrieval.

commit_until.comment: Optional inclusive UTC-aware commit history upper timestamp bound accepted by GitHub.

concurrency_group.comment: Exact concurrency group name within one repository; names are mutable operational identifiers.

conduct_key.comment: Exact code-of-conduct catalog key; omit to retrieve the complete catalog.

content_path.comment: Repository content path. The empty string selects the root directory; omission selects the preferred README unless readme_directory is supplied.

content_ref.comment: Commit, branch or tag for repository Contents/README retrieval; omission uses the repository default branch.

contributor_anonymous.comment: Set true or 1 to include anonymous contributor rows. Omitted follows GitHub's linked-account-only default; the API only links the first500 author email addresses. Allowed values: ["true", "1"]. Validated before retrieval.

copilot_report_day.comment: Exact UTC report day required by one-day Copilot report endpoints.

copilot_report_kind.comment: Copilot report metadata population: organization, repository, user/team mapping or user detail, for one requested day or the latest 28-day window. These endpoints return report links, not usage rows. Allowed values: ["organization_day", "organization_latest", "repositories_day", "user_teams_day", "users_day", "users_latest"]. Validated before retrieval.

copilot_space_number.comment: Copilot Space number within its explicitly selected organization or user owner.

copilot_space_resource_id.comment: Exact resource identity within the selected Copilot Space.

dependabot_alert_number.comment: Repository-local Dependabot alert number; identity also includes the stable repository ID.

dependabot_dismissal_org_status.comment: Organization dismissal-request status filter; also supports the organization-only completed and cancelled values. Response request status remains the pinned response enum. Allowed values: ["completed", "cancelled", "approved", "expired", "denied", "open", "all"]. Validated before retrieval.

dependabot_dismissal_period.comment: Dismissal-request lookback window. Omission uses the pinned API defaults: month for repository lists, day for organization lists. Set explicitly when comparing those populations; never all historical requests. Allowed values: ["hour", "day", "week", "month"]. Validated before retrieval.

dependabot_dismissal_repository_name.comment: Optional repository name without its owner, filtering organization dismissal requests.

dependabot_dismissal_requester.comment: Optional login of the user requesting Dependabot alert dismissal.

dependabot_dismissal_reviewer.comment: Optional login of a Dependabot dismissal reviewer, distinct from the requester.

dependabot_dismissal_status.comment: Repository dismissal-request status filter. The response uses pending for an open request. Allowed values: ["open", "approved", "expired", "denied", "all"]. Validated before retrieval.

dependabot_package.comment: Optional comma-separated dependency package names; these are not GitHub Packages registry identities.

dependabot_scope.comment: Optional vulnerable dependency execution scope. Allowed values: ["runtime", "development"]. Validated before retrieval.

dependabot_state.comment: Optional comma-separated Dependabot alert states; omission preserves the complete visible state population.

dependency_compare.comment: Dependency comparison lookup token in base...head form. Named refs can move; this is a comparison observation rather than a commit identity.

dependency_manifest.comment: Optional exact dependency manifest path relative to the repository root.

deployment_branch_policy_id.comment: Stable deployment branch or tag policy identity; requires repository and environment_name.

deployment_id.comment: Stable deployment identity within the selected repository.

deployment_protection_rule_id.comment: Stable custom deployment protection rule identity; requires repository and environment_name.

deployment_status_id.comment: Stable deployment status identity; requires repository and deployment_id.

discussion_comment_id.comment: Global node ID of a discussion comment whose threaded replies should be retrieved.

environment_name.comment: Exact environment name within the repository. Names are mutable; environment identity is its numeric ID.

follow_direction.comment: For authenticated follow listings, choose followers of the authenticated account or accounts it is following. Allowed values: ["followers", "following"]. Validated before retrieval.

followed_user.comment: Login of the account being followed, distinct from its followers.

follower_user.comment: Login of the account performing the follow, distinct from the followed account.

forks_of.comment: Parent repository as owner/name whose visible fork repositories are requested.

ghsa_id.comment: GitHub Security Advisory identifier for a repository advisory lookup; requires repository.

gist_comment_id.comment: One gist comment ID; requires gist_id.

gist_id.comment: One opaque GitHub gist ID; omit to discover the selected gist population.

gist_population.comment: Gist discovery population: visible uses the caller-owned listing when authenticated and public listing otherwise; public selects the public feed; starred selects the authenticated caller stars. Allowed values: ["visible", "public", "starred"]. Validated before retrieval.

gist_revision.comment: Optional exact gist revision SHA; filters the complete selected gist commit listing before revision hydration.

gist_since.comment: Only gists updated after this timestamp, applied by GitHub to the selected listing population.

git_commit_sha.comment: Exact Git commit object SHA, resolved through the Git database endpoint.

git_ref.comment: Commit SHA, branch or tag whose checks are selected; a branch or tag resolves at request time.

git_tag_sha.comment: Exact annotated Git tag object SHA; lightweight tags do not have tag objects.

gitignore_name.comment: Exact Gitignore template name; omit to retrieve every catalog template.

global_advisory_id.comment: GitHub Security Advisory identifier for global database lookup; the canonical output identity remains ghsa_id.

head_commit_sha.comment: Exact commit SHA whose current branch heads are selected.

issue_advanced_search.comment: Optional raw GitHub advanced_search query value for issue search; preserved as the pinned string parameter.

issue_assignee.comment: Optional REST issue assignee filter: login, * for any or none for unassigned.

issue_blocked_by.comment: Select issues blocking this repository-local issue number.

issue_blocking.comment: Select issues blocked by this repository-local issue number.

issue_children_of.comment: Select sub-issues of this repository-local parent issue; children may belong to other repositories.

issue_comment_id.comment: Exact numeric issue or PR conversation comment identity; distinct from review-comment ID.

issue_creator.comment: Optional REST issue original-author filter by login, distinct from assignee.

issue_event_id.comment: Exact numeric issue event identity in the selected repository.

issue_filter.comment: Authenticated-user issue participation filter: assigned, created, mentioned, subscribed or all. Default is assigned; these routes do not imply authorship.

issue_labels.comment: Optional comma-separated label names restricting REST issue discovery.

issue_mentioned.comment: Optional REST issue mention filter by login; not proof of authorship.

issue_milestone.comment: Optional REST issue milestone number text, * for any or none for no milestone.

issue_node_id.comment: Exact GraphQL Issue node identity, stable across repository transfer. Pull requests are a distinct node type.

issue_number.comment: Issue or pull-request number for conversation comments; requires repository.

issue_parent_of.comment: Select the parent of this repository-local issue number; the parent can belong to another repository.

issue_related_to.comment: Select issues related to this repository-local issue number.

issue_search_type.comment: Optional requested issue search mode. The actual performed mode and fallback reasons remain response metadata; omission preserves the API default. Allowed values: ["semantic", "hybrid"]. Validated before retrieval.

issue_since.comment: Optional last-updated lower bound for REST issue discovery; not creation time.

issue_state.comment: Optional REST discovery state: open, closed or all. Omission on a filtered REST route uses GitHub open default.

issue_suggestion_action.comment: Optional suggestion action filter: set_type, add_label, add_field, add_assignee or close_issue.

issue_suggestion_state.comment: Optional suggestion lifecycle filter; omission selects all states, including applied and dismissed.

label.comment: Exact repository label name; requires repository.

label_collection.comment: Select the complete repository label collection through REST discovery and canonical GraphQL hydration. Must be true. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

label_issue_number.comment: Select labels attached to this issue or pull-request number through the REST issue-label collection.

license_featured.comment: Optional GitHub featured filter for the license catalog; omission retains the complete commonly used catalog.

license_key.comment: Exact GitHub license catalog key; omit to retrieve the commonly used license catalog.

license_ref.comment: Optional Git ref for the repository license file; omission follows the repository default branch.

membership_user.comment: Account login whose organization membership or membership-check observation is selected.

merge_request_uuid.comment: Previously requested asynchronous merge UUID; retrieval never requests or performs a merge.

milestone_number.comment: Repository-local milestone number, distinct from milestone database or node ID.

milestone_state.comment: Optional milestone state: open, closed or all. Omission uses the all-state canonical population.

notification_before.comment: Only notifications updated before this timestamp, as filtered by GitHub.

notification_participating.comment: Optional GitHub participating filter for the caller notification listing.

notification_since.comment: Only notifications updated after this timestamp, as filtered by GitHub.

notification_thread_id.comment: One canonical decimal notification thread ID; the API wire identity is preserved as text and integer path conversion is validated.

octocat_speech.comment: Optional text for the Octocat speech bubble; omission uses GitHub default text.

organization.comment: Explicit GitHub organization scope. Mutually exclusive with owner and repository.

organization_directory.comment: Explicitly enumerate the global public organization directory; optionally start after organization_since_id. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

organization_invitation_id.comment: Exact organization invitation identity used to retrieve its associated teams.

organization_invitation_population.comment: Organization invitation lifecycle population: pending or failed. Accepted and canceled invitations are not an enumerated historical population. Allowed values: ["pending", "failed"]. Validated before retrieval.

organization_invitation_role.comment: Optional pending organization-invitation role filter; this is not a team role. Allowed values: ["all", "admin", "direct_member", "billing_manager", "hiring_manager"]. Validated before retrieval.

organization_invitation_source.comment: Optional pending invitation source filter. Allowed values: ["all", "member", "scim"]. Validated before retrieval.

organization_membership_check.comment: Check visible membership or public membership. A 404 does not establish absence of a private membership. Allowed values: ["visible", "public"]. Validated before retrieval.

organization_membership_state.comment: Optional authenticated membership state filter. Pending means an invitation has not been accepted; active member counts exclude pending rows. Allowed values: ["active", "pending"]. Validated before retrieval.

organization_public_members.comment: Select only publicly declared organization memberships; private membership is outside this retrieval population. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

organization_since_id.comment: Exclusive numeric organization-ID cursor for global directory retrieval; this scopes the returned population.

outside_collaborator_filter.comment: Credential-visible outside collaborator population, optionally limited by two-factor configuration. Allowed values: ["all", "2fa_disabled", "2fa_insecure"]. Validated before retrieval.

owner.comment: GitHub organization or user owner; user listings contain public owned repositories only. Mutually exclusive with repository and organization.

package_name.comment: Exact package name within the selected account and registry type.

package_population.comment: Select Docker migration conflicts rather than the normal registry inventory. Allowed values: ["docker_migration_conflicts"]. Validated before retrieval.

package_type.comment: Package registry type; part of the qualified package identity. Allowed values: ["npm", "maven", "rubygems", "docker", "nuget", "container"]. Validated before retrieval.

package_version_id.comment: Stable package version ID within the selected account, registry and package.

package_version_state.comment: Explicit active or deleted version listing; supported only for organizations and the authenticated account. Allowed values: ["active", "deleted"]. Validated before retrieval.

pages_build_id.comment: One GitHub Pages numeric build selector; requires one repository. The canonical response identity is the returned build URL because the pinned response has no numeric ID field.

pages_build_population.comment: Pages build population: all follows the retained paginated build listing; latest selects only the latest build for each repository. Omission means all. Allowed values: ["all", "latest"]. Validated before retrieval.

pages_deployment_id.comment: GitHub Pages deployment ID or commit SHA lookup token. The response does not provide a canonical deployment ID.

parent_gist_id.comment: One opaque parent gist ID whose current forks are selected.

parent_team_numeric_id.comment: Select immediate child teams of this stable parent team ID through the pinned legacy route.

parent_team_slug.comment: Select immediate child teams of this team slug; requires organization. This does not recursively enumerate descendants.

project_field_node_id.comment: Exact global field identity; can be combined with a numeric field ID as an intersection.

project_item_id.comment: Exact REST project item database ID; requires a project number and exactly one owner scope. Distinct from project_item_node_id and item content issue/PR IDs.

project_item_query.comment: GitHub Projects item search expression applied within each selected project. Requires an owner scope; compatible with project_number but not item or saved-view selectors.

project_items_rest.comment: Select all project items through the REST item collection and canonical node hydration. Must be true; requires an owner scope. Archived and redacted rows remain represented when returned by GitHub. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

project_owners.comment: Explicit organization or personal-user owner cohort. Each login resolves its account type; empty cohorts return no projects. Supply this cohort instead of owner, organization or user.

project_view_number.comment: Saved project view number; requires project_number. Selects the current items returned by that view, preserving GitHub view filters.

property_repository_query.comment: Optional GitHub repository-search filter on organization custom-property repository discovery. Returned assignments are hydrated from the canonical per-repository endpoint.

public_repositories.comment: Explicitly select the global public repository inventory; all advertised since-cursor pages are preserved. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

public_repository_since_id.comment: Only public repository IDs after this API creation-order cursor.

pull_request_number.comment: Optional one-PR scope; requires repository. NULL includes all open and closed PRs.

reaction_commit_comment_node_id.comment: Exact GraphQL CommitComment node identity; resolves the subject and its current repository before retrieving reactions.

reaction_content.comment: Optional exact reaction symbol. Comments and issue threads support +1, -1, laugh, confused, heart, hooray, rocket and eyes; releases support +1, laugh, heart, hooray, rocket and eyes. Omission includes every reaction type. Allowed values: ["+1", "-1", "laugh", "confused", "heart", "hooray", "rocket", "eyes"]. Validated before retrieval.

reaction_issue_comment_node_id.comment: Exact GraphQL IssueComment node identity; resolves the subject and its current repository before retrieving reactions.

readme_directory.comment: Directory in which to discover the preferred README; mutually exclusive with content_path.

recursive_tree_sha.comment: Exact root Git tree SHA; selects all recursively returned entries and rejects a truncated response.

ref_prefix.comment: Git reference prefix without refs/, such as heads/ or tags/. Empty text selects every Git namespace.

reference_name.comment: Exact Git reference without the refs/ prefix, such as heads/main or tags/v1.0.

release_asset_id.comment: Stable release asset ID within repository; requires repository. The direct asset response does not identify its parent release.

release_id.comment: Stable release ID within repository; requires repository. Mutually exclusive with release_tag and release_selection.

release_selection.comment: Use latest for GitHub's latest published non-prerelease release; requires repository. Mutually exclusive with release_id and release_tag. Allowed values: ["latest"]. Validated before retrieval.

release_tag.comment: Exact release tag; requires repository. Mutually exclusive with release_id and release_selection.

repositories.comment: Explicit repository cohort as owner/name values. Supply repositories or one of repository, owner and organization; an empty cohort returns zero counts. Names must be unique ignoring case.

repository.comment: One repository as owner/name. Mutually exclusive with owner and organization.

repository_access_type.comment: Legacy authenticated repository access population; incompatible with repository_visibility and repository_affiliation. Allowed values: ["all", "owner", "public", "private", "member"]. Validated before retrieval.

repository_activity_actor.comment: Repository change history actor login filter; distinct from repository owner.

repository_activity_after.comment: Opaque repository activity cursor selecting results after a known cursor.

repository_activity_before.comment: Opaque repository activity cursor selecting results before a known cursor.

repository_activity_direction.comment: Repository change history ordering. Allowed values: ["asc", "desc"]. Validated before retrieval.

repository_activity_period.comment: Repository change history relative time window; omission preserves the API default. Allowed values: ["day", "week", "month", "quarter", "year"]. Validated before retrieval.

repository_activity_ref.comment: Repository change history ref filter; full ref such as refs/heads/main.

repository_activity_type.comment: Repository change history operation type. Allowed values: ["push", "force_push", "branch_creation", "branch_deletion", "pr_merge", "merge_queue_merge"]. Validated before retrieval.

repository_affiliation.comment: Comma-separated authenticated repository affiliations: owner, collaborator, organization_member. Incompatible with repository_access_type.

repository_direction.comment: Ordering direction for authenticated repository results. Allowed values: ["asc", "desc"]. Validated before retrieval.

repository_fork_sort.comment: API ordering for the complete fork inventory. Allowed values: ["newest", "oldest", "stargazers", "watchers"]. Validated before retrieval.

repository_pushed_before.comment: Only authenticated repositories pushed before this instant.

repository_pushed_since.comment: Only authenticated repositories pushed after this instant.

repository_sort.comment: Ordering of authenticated repository results, without truncating the selected population. Allowed values: ["created", "updated", "pushed", "full_name"]. Validated before retrieval.

repository_visibility.comment: Authenticated repository visibility filter; incompatible with repository_access_type. Allowed values: ["all", "public", "private"]. Validated before retrieval.

review_comment_id.comment: Stable review comment ID within the selected repository; does not require an invented pull request number.

review_id.comment: Pull request review ID; requires repository and pull_request_number.

rule_evaluation_actor.comment: Login of the actor whose pushes triggered rule evaluation.

rule_evaluation_mode.comment: Filter active or evaluate-mode rule suites. Allowed values: ["all", "active", "evaluate"]. Validated before retrieval.

rule_evaluation_ref.comment: Exact ref filter for rule evaluation suites; GitHub does not accept wildcard refs.

rule_evaluation_repository.comment: Repository name filter within the selected organization rule-suite population.

rule_evaluation_result.comment: Filter active-rule suite outcomes. Allowed values: ["pass", "fail", "bypass", "all"]. Validated before retrieval.

rule_evaluation_time_period.comment: Rolling time window of observed rule evaluation suites; omission uses the API default day. Allowed values: ["hour", "day", "week", "month"]. Validated before retrieval.

run_id.comment: Workflow run identity; a rerun retains this identity.

search_code_sort.comment: Optional GitHub code search sort field; omission retains best-match ordering. Allowed values: ["indexed"]. Validated before retrieval.

search_commits_sort.comment: Optional GitHub commits search sort field; omission retains best-match ordering. Allowed values: ["author-date", "committer-date"]. Validated before retrieval.

search_issues_sort.comment: Optional GitHub issues search sort field; omission retains best-match ordering. Allowed values: ["comments", "reactions", "reactions-+1", "reactions--1", "reactions-smile", "reactions-thinking_face", "reactions-heart", "reactions-tada", "interactions", "created", "updated"]. Validated before retrieval.

search_labels_sort.comment: Optional GitHub labels search sort field; omission retains best-match ordering. Allowed values: ["created", "updated"]. Validated before retrieval.

search_order.comment: Optional REST search result order; omission preserves the API default. Allowed values: ["desc", "asc"]. Validated before retrieval.

search_query.comment: Exact GitHub REST search query text. Query syntax and searchable population depend on the selected search entity; no query rewriting or authorization widening is performed.
