search_repositories_sort.comment: Optional GitHub repositories search sort field; omission retains best-match ordering. Allowed values: ["stars", "forks", "help-wanted-issues", "updated"]. Validated before retrieval.

search_users_sort.comment: Optional GitHub users search sort field; omission retains best-match ordering. Allowed values: ["followers", "repositories", "joined"]. Validated before retrieval.

secret_scanning_alert_number.comment: Repository-local secret scanning alert number, distinct from code scanning alerts, issues or PR numbers.

secret_scanning_assignee.comment: Optional alert assignee login. Assignee is distinct from resolver and bypass requester.

secret_scanning_bypass_number.comment: Repository-local delegated secret scanning push-protection bypass request number, distinct from alert number.

secret_scanning_bypass_status.comment: Optional bypass request filter using the API supported request_status values.

secret_scanning_bypassed.comment: Optional exact push-protection bypass filter; false selects alerts not caused by bypass, true selects bypassed alerts.

secret_scanning_dismissal_status.comment: Optional dismissal request filter: open, approved, expired, denied or all. Response pending corresponds to an open request.

secret_scanning_exclude_providers.comment: Optional comma-separated provider slug identifiers excluded from alert discovery.

secret_scanning_exclude_secret_types.comment: Optional comma-separated secret type identifiers excluded from alert discovery.

secret_scanning_hide_secret.comment: Whether to hide literal secret values in API responses. Omission uses the API default; hidden or absent values are not interpreted as empty secrets.

secret_scanning_included_metadata.comment: Optional comma-separated metadata keys that must all exist on discovered alerts.

secret_scanning_multi_repo.comment: Optional API is_multi_repo tag filter. True requires the tag; false follows the API default rather than establishing unique exposure.

secret_scanning_owner_email_hash.comment: Optional lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of owner email used by the server metadata filter.

secret_scanning_pattern_push_protection.comment: Optional custom-pattern push-protection setting: enabled or disabled.

secret_scanning_pattern_state.comment: Optional custom-pattern publication state: published or unpublished.

secret_scanning_providers.comment: Optional comma-separated provider slug identifiers selecting alerts.

secret_scanning_publicly_leaked.comment: Optional API is_publicly_leaked tag filter. True requires the tag; false follows the API no-tag-filter default rather than asserting no exposure.

secret_scanning_request_period.comment: Lookback window for delegated request collections: hour, day, week or month. Omission uses the API month default; not all historical requests.

secret_scanning_request_requester.comment: Optional delegated bypass or dismissal requester login, distinct from reviewer.

secret_scanning_request_reviewer.comment: Optional delegated bypass or dismissal request reviewer login.

secret_scanning_resolution.comment: Optional comma-separated alert resolution identifiers, such as revoked, false_positive, wont_fix or used_in_tests.

secret_scanning_secret_type.comment: Optional comma-separated secret type identifiers selecting alerts.

secret_scanning_state.comment: Optional secret scanning alert state, open or resolved.

secret_scanning_validity.comment: Optional comma-separated latest validity states: active, inactive or unknown. Validity is not inferred from alert state.

security_campaign_number.comment: Organization-local security campaign number, qualified by the stable organization ID.

security_campaign_state.comment: Optional security campaign state; omission includes open and closed campaigns. Allowed values: ["open", "closed"]. Validated before retrieval.

stack_number.comment: Repository-local pull request stack number; stable stack identity remains stack_id.

team_member_role.comment: Effective team member role filter; omission uses all roles. Child-team members can be inherited. Allowed values: ["member", "maintainer", "all"]. Validated before retrieval.

team_member_user.comment: Account login for an exact team membership or membership-check observation.

team_membership_check.comment: Select the pinned legacy 204/404 membership observation, rather than a membership-object record. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

team_numeric_id.comment: Exact stable team identity through pinned legacy numeric routes; GitHub marks these routes as closing down. Prefer organization plus team_slug where available.

team_repository_check.comment: Select a team/repository visibility check: 404 is unconfirmed access and can reflect insufficient caller permission. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

team_repository_permission.comment: Select an exact typed team/repository permission object using the pinned repository media representation. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

team_slug.comment: Slug of one team; requires organization.

traffic_granularity.comment: Traffic bucket aggregation: day or week. Omission means day. Both retain the current rolling 14-day response window. Allowed values: ["day", "week"]. Validated before retrieval.

tree_sha.comment: Exact Git tree SHA; returns direct child entries only.

user.comment: One personal GitHub user login, including work in repositories owned by other accounts.

user_account_id.comment: Stable numeric account ID for the canonical personal User-only population. Organization and Bot accounts are outside that population.

user_context_subject_id.comment: Opaque hovercard context subject ID; requires user_context_subject_type. This is not an issue/PR number.

user_context_subject_type.comment: Hovercard context subject type; requires user_context_subject_id. The subject is distinct from the user being described. Allowed values: ["organization", "repository", "issue", "pull_request"]. Validated before retrieval.

user_directory.comment: Explicitly enumerate the global public account directory, retaining only personal User accounts and hydrating canonical profiles. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

user_email_population.comment: Select all email addresses visible to the authenticated account, or only its public addresses. Allowed values: ["all", "public"]. Validated before retrieval.

user_since_id.comment: Optional exclusive numeric account-ID cursor for global directory retrieval; results cover only accounts after this ID.

users.comment: Personal-user cohort. Supply users or user; an empty cohort returns zero counts. Each login must be nonempty and unique ignoring case.

viewer_issues.comment: Select /issues across repositories visible to the authenticated user; requires a token. Must be true. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

viewer_member_issues.comment: Select /user/issues across owned and member repositories for the authenticated user. Must be true. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

viewer_organization_issues.comment: Select /orgs/{org}/issues for the authenticated user in the selected organization. Must be true. Allowed values: [true]. Validated before retrieval.

workflow_id.comment: Numeric workflow identity; distinct from the mutable workflow name.
